name: readback
description: Reads back a short spoken summary at the end of every reply, without changing the reply itself. Local TTS by default; nothing is ever recorded.

PROVIDER.title: Voice engine
PROVIDER.description: auto (recommended): ElevenLabs if key and voice id are set, then Kokoro, then the macOS system voice. Or force elevenlabs, kokoro or say.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.title: ElevenLabs API key
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: From elevenlabs.io > Developers > API keys. Kept in your system keychain.

ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.title: ElevenLabs voice id
ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.description: The ID (not the name) of your voice, from My Voices. Voice Library voices need a paid plan.

PERSONA.title: Personality
PERSONA.description: companion (warm, default), sarcastic (dry humor), serious (calm, no jokes) or professional (clear, client-style). Changes how the spoken line is written and the voice stability.

ELEVENLABS_MODEL.title: ElevenLabs model
ELEVENLABS_MODEL.description: eleven_flash_v2_5 is fast and cheap (default). eleven_v4 is more expressive and costs double.

LANGUAGE.title: Language code
LANGUAGE.description: es or en. Helps pronunciation and picks the backup system voice. Empty means auto.

VOLUME.title: Playback volume
VOLUME.description: 1.0 is normal. Raise it if music drowns the voice. Above 2 may distort.

SHOW_USAGE.title: Show credit footer
SHOW_USAGE.description: on shows a one-line ElevenLabs usage footer after each reply (never read by the AI). off hides it.

SPEED.title: Speech rate
SPEED.description: 1.0 is normal. Below 1 is slower, above is faster

VOICE.title: Voice
VOICE.description: Kokoro voice id. af_heart / af_sky for English, ef_dora / em_alex for Spanish
